Subject: Observability seat + audit-log retention pricing for MedSentry

Hi Cynthia / Daniel —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation, I put together two concrete packaging options for compliance-related components (audit logs, KMS/HSM usage, and long-term retention evidence) so procurement can evaluate tradeoffs quickly. Attached is a one-page summary and a draft SOW for a pilot. High level:

Option A — Minimal compliance footprint (lower CAPEX)
- Audit log retention: 90 days included. Extended retention tiers: 1 year @ $0.14/GB/month; 7 year archival tier for compliance export @ $0.08/GB/month.
- Observability seat: $1,200/month (per seat) — includes full console access, token-level cost dashboards, 30-day trace retention, and 1 sysadmin user for audit exports.
- HSM (per-pulse model): $0.025 per HSM operation (sign/unwrap) with a monthly soft cap of $2,500 after which we negotiate an overage rate.

Option B — Compliance bundle for regulated customers (recommended for pilots expecting longer retention)
- Audit log retention: 7-year archival included in bundle (all logs + export support).
- Observability seat: $900/month (per seat) with a 12-month commitment.
- HSM: optional dedicated HSM seat at $3,750/month that covers up to 250k operations; excess at $0.01/op.
- Evidence bundle (one-time): $35,000 includes redacted SOC2 Type II package access, 7-year export packaging, and two assisted audit exports.

Pilot proposal (3 months)
- 50% off the observability seat for the pilot and waived SOW setup fee.
- We’ll provide a redacted SOC2 evidence bundle for review under an NDA.

Questions for you so we can finalize a SOW:
- Confirm whether MedSentry needs US-only storage for audit logs or EU for any subset of data.
- Expected audit log volume (GB/month) for sizing HSM and retention tiers.
- Whether procurement prefers a one-time evidence bundle versus ongoing retention line items.

Next steps: if this aligns, I’ll circulate SOW-draft-v1 with the pilot terms and loop Legal.

Thanks —
Ben

Thanks Ben — helpful breakdown. A couple of clarifying asks before we take this to procurement: 

1) Line-itemization 
- We need a clean export-friendly line item list (price, unit, metric) that we can drop into our procurement tool. Can you provide per-GB, per-seat, per-op lines with examples (if we expect ~10TB/month ingested, what would Option A vs B look like)?

2) Evidence / SOC2
- We will need access to a redacted SOC2 Type II report and any supporting artifacts under NDA. Can you share that in the pilot? Any legal constraints on what you can redact?

3) Residency / egress
- Confirm residency options — our default is US-only, but legal may ask for EU for a specific tenant. Also clarify how egress is measured and whether the audit export (7-year) triggers egress charges. If it does, we need an estimate.

4) Discounting for annual commit
- If we move from a pilot to a 12-month commitment covering both Observability seats (2 seats) and the HSM seat, what discount can Redwood offer?

If you can reply with a short table / sample math and confirm the SOC2 availability, I’ll route to Procurement for a PO.

— Cynthia
Head of Procurement, MedSentry

Hi Cynthia — copying Ben / Tessa. Quick answers and a small alternative we’ve seen close faster with healthcare customers. Attaching a redacted SOC2 extract for your legal team.

Line-item example (approximate math for 10TB/month ingestion):
- Audit log ingest: 10,000 GB * $0.14 = $1,400/month (1-year tier).
- Active observability seats: 2 * $1,200 = $2,400/month (Option A pricing).
- HSM (per-pulse): assume 200k ops/month * $0.025 = $5,000/month (soft cap would have kicked; under Option B a dedicated seat is cheaper).
- Total (Option A): ~$8,800/month (pre-discount; excludes egress).

Alternative (faster procurement path) — Hybrid Evidence Seat
- One-time Evidence Seat activation fee: $20,000 (includes 7-year export packaging, two assisted exports, and access to redacted SOC2 artifacts).
- Monthly observability access: $750/month/seat for first year when Evidence Seat purchased (reduces monthly cashflow).
- HSM: Offer a capped plan: $1,800/month covers up to 100k ops; additional ops $0.015/op.

Residency / egress notes:
- We can provision audit-log archival buckets in US-East or EU-West. If export is triggered (assisted export package), we’ll waive egress fees for up to two audit exports per 12-month period as part of the Evidence Seat. Additional exports billed at standard egress rates (we’ll provide a table).

SOC2 availability:
- We can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II and supporting controls matrix under NDA. The attached PDF is redacted; Legal can request any additional artifacts and we’ll route through Security for a controlled disclosure.

Discounts for annual commit:
- For a 12-month committed contract covering observability seats + HSM committed seat we can offer 18% off list (Option B price points) OR a blended 15% off if you need month-to-month flexibility after a 3-month pilot.

I’ll prepare a short sample pricing export and a tracked SOW change so procurement can paste line items into their system.

Adding a technical note to help with sizing and egress estimates: 

- Ingest format: recommend compressed JSONL (gzipped) for audit logs; typical compression ratios 3–6x which affects GB/month numbers used in pricing. If MedSentry can send logs compressed we’ll provide more favorable per-GB math.
- Retention tiers: for the archival (7-year) we use object storage with lifecycle transitions (hot -> warm -> archive). Storage cost in our price covers S3 storage only; network egress for downloads is passed through at cost unless waived per the Evidence Seat.
- HSM ops: if you use the HSM for symmetric key unwrapping on every call we recommend the dedicated HSM seat. The per-op model is good for low-frequency signing. For 200k ops/month, dedicated seat is almost always cheaper.
- Residency: we’ll provision a tenant-specific key in the region you choose; if you elect EU for a subset we can mirror logs to EU with a replication charge (one-time setup + ongoing storage).

If you send a short sample of one week of logs (redacted) we’ll run a quick sizing run and produce updated per-GB numbers (and estimated egress for a one-time export).

— Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
